data.name: PageDescription
data.value: Record, investigate and decide carrier claims for shipments.

data.name: EmptyState
data.value: No claims match the current filter.

data.name: ApprovedAmountNotListed
data.value: The approved amount is not part of the list data; it is shown in the confirmation after an approval.

data.name: ResolveFirst
data.value: Look up the shipment before creating the claim.

data.name: EligibilityNote
data.value: A claim can be created for shipments that are Dispatched, In Transit, Delivered, Exception or Closed.

data.name: ShipmentIneligible
data.value: This shipment’s status does not allow a claim.

data.name: NoShipmentCarrier
data.value: Available only when the looked-up shipment has a carrier.

data.name: AmountHelp
data.value: Sent exactly as typed, for example 250.00.

data.name: CurrencyHelp
data.value: Three-letter code sent exactly as typed, for example EUR.

data.name: EvidenceHelp
data.value: Optional. References are sent in the order shown.

data.name: ClaimCreateReplayed
data.value: This claim was already created by the same request and is shown as completed.

data.name: SettledNoPaymentNote
data.value: Settling changes only the claim status. No payment, payable or receivable is posted.

data.name: OccurredAtHelp
data.value: Date and time with offset, for example 2026-09-26T14:30:00+03:00.

data.name: ApprovedAmountHelp
data.value: Required for approval; from zero up to the claimed amount.

data.name: ConfirmTransition
data.value: Change the claim status to the selected value?

data.name: TransitionReplayed
data.value: This status change was already applied by the same request and is shown as completed.

data.name: RequestPending
data.value: A request for this action is still in progress.

data.name: ErrInvalidRequest
data.value: The request is not valid. Check the entered values.

data.name: ErrUnauthenticated
data.value: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

data.name: ErrForbidden
data.value: You are not authorized for this action.

data.name: ErrClaimNotFound
data.value: The record was not found or is not available to you.

data.name: ErrUnsupportedMediaType
data.value: The request format is not supported.

data.name: ErrClaimShipmentIneligible
data.value: The shipment’s status does not allow a claim.

data.name: ErrClaimCarrierMismatch
data.value: The carrier does not match the shipment’s carrier or cannot be used.

data.name: ErrClaimAmountInvalid
data.value: The claimed amount must be greater than zero.

data.name: ErrClaimApprovalAmountInvalid
data.value: The approved amount must be between zero and the claimed amount.

data.name: ErrClaimApprovedAmountNotAllowed
data.value: An approved amount can be sent only when approving.

data.name: ErrInvalidClaimTransition
data.value: The claim has changed in the meantime and this status change is no longer possible. The list has been reloaded.

data.name: ErrClaimCorrelationMismatch
data.value: The request no longer matches the shipment record.

data.name: ErrIdempotencyKeyReused
data.value: This request was already received with different values. To make a different request, close this form and open a new one.

data.name: ErrClaimReferenceInvalid
data.value: The shipment reference data is invalid. Please contact support.

data.name: ErrClaimReferenceIncomplete
data.value: The shipment reference data is incomplete. Try the same request again later.

data.name: ErrClaimReferenceUnavailable
data.value: The shipment reference data is temporarily unavailable. Try the same request again.

data.name: ErrClaimStorageUnavailable
data.value: Claims are temporarily unavailable. The outcome is not confirmed; try the same request again.

data.name: ErrInternalError
data.value: An unexpected error occurred. You can retry the same action.
